desc: Parse the \(N\times N\) adjacency-character matrix and group incoming/outgoing edges by label.
Construct the \(N^2\) pair states and initialize distances to zero for diagonal pairs and one for directly connected pairs.
Generate reverse pair transitions for each popped state using equal-label incoming/outgoing edge combinations, with correct endpoint orientation.
Run Dijkstra with duplicate queue entries and stale-entry checks.
Assess and optimize transition generation for dense graphs and \(N=100\).
Format and print the \(N\times N\) distance matrix, replacing unreachable values with \(-1\).
